This latter compound is also linked to the cAMP-dependent protein kinase catalytic subunit alpha. The scores for these relationships are consistent, indicating a plausible biological pathway. The mechanism appears to involve the inhibition of a downstream enzyme, which may modulate the activity of the cAMP-dependent protein kinase. The evidence supports a possible regulatory role for these compounds in cellular processes, though the exact functional significance remains to be determined.
